instances.claim: This tells me that the object was expected to disappear, dematerialize, or lose its physical standing — and that something had to hold it in place against that.
instances.why: "Remained" and "buoyed into physicality" are both recoveries from a threat, but nothing earlier in the draft puts the object under any threat of vanishing: lines 1–4 establish only a price gap and a reproduction count, both of which affirm the object's physical presence rather than endanger it. The premise the line concludes from — that readymades or conceptual gestures dissolve the object into idea — is not in the piece.
